objective: Fresh independent fault-finding review of the final frozen CW-10 candidate against every approved requirement and prior defect class.
prior_findings: worker execution/judgment must be bound to exact public OMP response identity, not OMP_PROCESSED alone
current pause/cancel/revocation authority must be re-read before dispatch and analysis/report
direct worker requests must create durable Task/revision/approval/proceed boundaries
environment values must remain transient and never be persisted
bool, float, negative, unsafe integer, malformed UUID, stale and replayed response identities must fail closed
constraints: Review-only: do not edit or execute mutating actions.
Inspect the frozen candidate itself and independently validate exact source/test/guide hashes where relevant.
Report findings in severity order with file/line evidence; explicitly say no findings if clean.
